title: CSA Subscription Form
subtitle: Community-Supported Agriculture Subscription: captures actual activity and handoff.
description: CSA Subscription Form covers subscriber, share plan, season, pickup site, distribution, substitution, credit, and communication. The CSA program coordinator records Community-Supported Agriculture Subscription activity, quantities, variance, and handoff. CSA Subscription Form keeps Community-Supported Agriculture Subscription exceptions visible until the CSA program coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use CSA Subscription Form at farm program, packing point, pickup site, delivery route, and subscriber handoff. Document subscriber, share plan, season, pickup site, distribution, substitution, credit, and communication identity before Community-Supported Agriculture Subscription begins. Compare subscriber, share plan, season, pickup site, distribution, substitution, credit, and communication findings with stated Community-Supported Agriculture Subscription criteria; route unresolved Community-Supported Agriculture Subscription issues to farm subscription operations reviewer.

sections.title: Operating context and subject identity
sections.guidance: For Community-Supported Agriculture Subscription, identify responsible parties, farm program, packing point, pickup site, delivery route, and subscriber handoff, and the linked subscriber, share plan, season, pickup site, distribution, substitution, credit, and communication source.

sections.title: Activity observations and operating checks
sections.guidance: Capture Community-Supported Agriculture Subscription facts for subscriber, share plan, season, pickup site, distribution, substitution, credit, and communication; include result, limit, source, and next control.

items: Share contents and source lot where needed

sections.title: Retained evidence and next operating review
sections.guidance: Resolve open Community-Supported Agriculture Subscription conditions; have CSA program coordinator assign the next Community-Supported Agriculture Subscription owner and transfer its retained record.

blocks.label: Operating exceptions, holds, and retained evidence
blocks.guidance: Pause Community-Supported Agriculture Subscription when subscription terms, payment, pickup authority, communication, or share disposition remains unresolved. Retain the available Community-Supported Agriculture Subscription proof and route unresolved subscriber, share plan, season, pickup site, distribution, substitution, credit, and communication scope to CSA program coordinator.
